meta.title: Vendor Masking on a live Auction event
gaps: Verify that every real vendor name is replaced and that no real vendor names remain anywhere on the auction screen.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that every real vendor name is replaced and that no real vendor names remain anywhere on the auction screen.

plan.title: Enable vendor masking on live auction

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live auction event with participating vendors.
Navigate to the live Auction stage screen required by the case.
Open the Actions menu on the auction screen.
Confirm the masking action is offered before selecting it.
Enable vendor masking for the live auction.
Verify the first participating vendor is displayed using a masked alias.
Verify the second participating vendor is displayed using a masked alias.
